It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
